How prices, language and checkout work

This site is where you browse. The store, run on Shopify, handles the cart, payment and shipping, so checkout always happens there.

Prices in the store are in US dollars. Choose CAD in the menu at the top and the amounts here are converted at the Bank of Canada exchange rate, looked up once when you open the site and kept for your whole visit. The converted amount is an estimate; the store shows the final amount at checkout.

Choose English or Français in the same menu to change the language of this site. When you open a product, your country choice is passed to the store; the store shows its own languages.
